001package dev.nandi0813.api.Event;
002
003import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.FightType;
004import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.FFA;
005import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Match;
006import dev.nandi0813.api.Interface.Spectatable;
007import lombok.Getter;
008import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
009import org.bukkit.event.Event;
010import org.bukkit.event.HandlerList;
011
012/**
013 * Fired once per confirmed death, after stats are updated and before the round/match reacts to it.
014 * Not fired for event game modes in 2.4.0. Fired on the main thread. Not cancellable.
015 */
016@Getter
017public class FightDeathEvent extends Event {
018
019    private static final HandlerList handlers = new HandlerList();
020
021    /** The player who died, never null. */
022    private final Player victim;
023    /** The killer, or null if the victim died without a killer. */
024    private final Player killer;
025    /** The type of the fight, never null. */
026    private final FightType fightType;
027    /** The fight ({@link Match} or {@link FFA}), never null. */
028    private final Spectatable fight;
029    /** The ladder name, never null. */
030    private final String ladderName;
031    /** The death message in MiniMessage format, or null if none is sent. */
032    private final String deathMessage;
033
034    /**
035     * Create a new fight death event.
036     * @param victim The player who died
037     * @param killer The killer, nullable
038     * @param fightType The type of the fight
039     * @param fight The fight
040     * @param ladderName The ladder name
041     * @param deathMessage The death message in MiniMessage format, nullable
042     */
043    public FightDeathEvent(Player victim, Player killer, FightType fightType, Spectatable fight, String ladderName, String deathMessage) {
044        this.victim = victim;
045        this.killer = killer;
046        this.fightType = fightType;
047        this.fight = fight;
048        this.ladderName = ladderName;
049        this.deathMessage = deathMessage;
050    }
051
052    /**
053     * Check whether the victim was killed by a player.
054     * @return true if the victim was killed by a player
055     */
056    public boolean hasKiller() {
057        return killer != null;
058    }
059
060    /**
061     * Get the fight as a match.
062     * @return The fight as a {@link Match}, or null if the fight is not a match
063     */
064    public Match getMatch() {
065        return fight instanceof Match ? (Match) fight : null;
066    }
067
068    /**
069     * Get the fight as an FFA.
070     * @return The fight as an {@link FFA}, or null if the fight is not an FFA
071     */
072    public FFA getFfa() {
073        return fight instanceof FFA ? (FFA) fight : null;
074    }
075
076    @Override
077    public HandlerList getHandlers() {
078        return handlers;
079    }
080
081    /**
082     * Get the handler list of this event.
083     * @return The handler list
084     */
085    public static HandlerList getHandlerList() {
086        return handlers;
087    }
088
089}
